title: FGSM Attack Transferability from Simulation to Quantum Hardware in Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.40701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum computers are now available through cloud platforms, and recent work has proposed using them to detect network intrusions. It is not yet clear how easily such systems can be attacked. We train a hybrid variational quantum classifier (VQC) on the Friday DDoS subset of CICIDS2017 and test it against two attacks: label flipping during training and FGSM evasion at prediction time. We run the tests in simulation and on IBM hardware, the Fez superconducting processor (Heron r2). We find that two models with similar accuracy can differ greatly in how easily they are attacked. A model that decides with little confidence loses half its detections to a very small change in the input, while a model trained to decide with more confidence needs a much larger change before it fails. Attacks built in simulation against the more confident model also work on real hardware, and the device classifies every unaltered attack sample correctly. Simul

translated_title: 网络入侵检测中FGSM攻击从仿真到量子硬件的可迁移性研究
translated_abstract: 量子计算机如今已可通过云平台获取，近期有研究提出利用它们来检测网络入侵。然而，这类系统有多容易受到攻击尚不清楚。我们在CICIDS2017数据集的周五DDoS子集上训练了一个混合变分量子分类器（VQC），并针对两种攻击进行了测试：训练阶段的标签翻转攻击和预测阶段的FGSM逃逸攻击。我们在仿真环境和IBM真实硬件——Fez超导处理器（Heron r2）上运行了这些测试。我们发现，两个准确率相近的模型在易受攻击的程度上可能存在巨大差异：一个以较低置信度做决策的模型，仅需对输入进行极小的改动就会损失一半的检测能力；而一个被训练为以更高置信度做决策的模型，则需要大得多的改动才会失效。此外，在仿真中针对高置信度模型构建的攻击在真实硬件上同样有效，而该硬件设备能正确分类每一个未经改动的攻击样本。
tldr: 该研究首次在真实IBM量子硬件上验证了仿真中构建的FGSM对抗攻击对量子网络入侵检测系统的可迁移性，并发现模型的决策置信度是决定其对抗鲁棒性的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that FGSM adversarial attacks crafted in simulation successfully transfer to real IBM quantum hardware in quantum-based network intrusion detection, and that a model's decision confidence is a key factor determining its adversarial robustness.
